t: You're at Middle Temple, one of the four Inns of Court that can call their members to the English Bar as barristers. The others are Inner Temple, Gray's Inn and Lincoln's Inn. It sits in the wider Temple area, near the Royal Courts of Justice, within the City of London. As a liberty, it works largely as an independent local authority. Several people have connections here. William Ettrick, a Member of Parliament, was born here, and Sir George Bowyer, a barrister and Liberal politician, died here.
